fact: UNDP reported on 23 August 2024 the launch of E-Taxe in 12 pilot communes with UNDP technical and financial support, and the minister urged extension to all 42 communes by the end of the year.
title: Le PNUD appuie la digitalisation de la fiscalité communale à travers E-Taxe
publisher: Programme des Nations Unies pour le développement (PNUD) Burundi
